description: Angular component for a key-value map input, including form handling, validation, and data binding.

classes.name: KeyValMapComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing a key-value map with validation and form controls.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and subscribes to value changes.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: keyValsFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of key-value controls.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a key-value map.

methods.name: removeKeyVal
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair at a specified index.

methods.name: addKeyVal
methods.description: Adds a new empty key-value pair to the form.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the bound model with current form data.
